_fixture.description: Valid Stripe webhook payload. All upstream nodes pass (signature, filter, idempotency, fetches, decomposition, validation). The Xero POST fails because the OAuth2 credential is expired/invalidated. After 3 retries with 2000ms backoff, the error routes through Branch Xero Error 4xx vs 5xx. Expired credentials typically return 401 Unauthorized from Xero, which is in [400, 500), so this lands in the 4xx envelope and returns HTTP 422 to the caller.
_fixture.expected_outcome: HTTP 422, result=FAILED, failed_check=xero_4xx, message='Xero 4xx' (or the Xero error body). payouts row FAILED with failed_check=xero_4xx. payout_uuid set. FAILED posting_event written. Slack alert via WF99.
_fixture.replay_instructions: Temporarily revoke or invalidate the Xero OAuth2 credential in the n8n UI (disconnect the account, or wait for the refresh token to expire). Then send the webhook_event body to POST {webhook_url}/stripe-payout-paid with a valid Stripe-Signature. After test, reconnect the Xero credential.

alternative_5xx_test._note: To exercise the 5xx path (network failure → treated as 5xx, NOT success): point the POST Xero Manual Journal URL at a sinkhole (e.g. https://10.255.255.1/api.xro/2.0/ManualJournals) so the connection times out. After retries exhaust, the error output fires with no httpCode (or with a low-level networking error). The Branch IF false branch routes to Set 502 Xero 5xx envelope. Confirm HTTP 502 in the response and failed_check=xero_5xx in the payouts row.
